semantics.statusIs: Evidence class of a statement, not an ordered confidence score or universal admission gate.
semantics.importEdges: Line-anchored lexical static import/re-export references only. Dynamic imports, dependency injection, DOM events and external runtime behavior are not exhaustively inferred.
semantics.sourceRefs: Repository-relative path, frozen Git blob identity and optional literal anchor/line at source.commit.
semantics.createdAt: Knowledge capture time; preserves original evidence timestamps; not a new test or provider verification time.
semantics.freshness: Compare all 184 frozen files plus newly discovered project files. Knowledge files and root AGENTS.md are publication overlay, not part of the pre-knowledge commit.
semantics.observations: Historical/local/browser records retain their own condition and revision scopes; source hash agreement is not independent verification of record truth.

nodes.conditionAndStrategy: 默认省略思考字段；精确本地规则匹配或手选模板，范围外组合暂不接纳

nodes.label: D-04 防重复消耗
nodes.conditionAndStrategy: 单次网络失败不自动重试；图片调用走当前确认回调和调用快照
nodes.tradeoffAlternativesRevisit: 不表示自动重试或批量授权永远不合理；候选应定义授权范围、幂等性、预算、失败分类与取消关系，再单独验收

nodes.label: 部分契约目标仍是通用 declared-effect 标签

nodes.label: completed 与 completion 的不同层级
nodes.summary: 页面 send 的 completed 表示处理流程返回；agent completion 可为 unknown；二者都不等于业务目标完成。
